items.title: 〈台股盤前要聞〉富邦006208分割投票開跑、華南金前10月獲利284億元超過去年
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Pre‑Market News: Fubon 006208 Split Vote Starts, Hua Nan Financial Q1‑Q3 Net Profit 28.456 B Reaches Year‑Ahead of 2023
paras:
台股盤前要聞

1.富邦投信26日舉辦富邦台50 ETF(006208-TW)分割投票啟動記者會，宣布自11月27日至12月15日開放電子投票，並於12月18日以書面方式召開受益人會議，期盼透過分割降低投資門檻，提升資金配置彈性。006208於2012年6月22日成立，初次發行價格為30元，本次分割倍數暫估為1拆7。若以每單位淨值210元為例，分割後淨值將調整為30元，一張變七張，按淨值估算的整張交易金額由21萬元降至3萬元。
2. 華南金 (2880-TW) 26日舉辦2026年第3季線上法人說明會，受惠於銀行核心業務穩健與非銀行子公司獲利大增，前10月稅後純益284.56億元，提前超越去年全年獲利。總經理蕭玉美表示，明年發放2026年度股利時，配發率將朝70%邁進，且原則上以現金股利為主，「配發水準可望優於今年」。
3.台北股市26日早盤由跌深反彈的電子股帶頭衝鋒，終場大盤上漲956.38點作，收盤報39151.81點，成交值萎縮爲8174.68億元。外資仍站在賣方，單日在集中市場賣超外資賣超491.81億元，本土投信及自營商則以買超對應今天的台股反彈格局。
4. 在輝達創辦人黃仁勳回鍋執行長的重大利多激勵下，台股於11月24日上演強勁慶祝行情，超過50檔ETF罕見同步亮燈漲停。然而，證交所26日公告，主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)爆出高達1.03億元的鉅額違約交割，由華南永昌證券中正分公司及國泰證券敦南分公司申報，成為主動式ETF首例。
5. 半導體測試介面廠穎崴(6515-TW)26日舉行法說會，董事長王嘉煌表示，受惠AI、高效能運算(HPC)需求持續成長，主要AI晶片客戶對明年需求相當積極，明年GPU、ASIC相關需求預估都將高於今年，從目前業務端掌握的資訊來看，明年營運成長幅度可望達雙位數以上。

paras_en: Fubon Asset Management held a press conference on the 26th to launch the split voting for its Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208‑TW). Electronic voting will be open from Nov 27 to Dec 15, with a written beneficiary meeting on Dec 18. The split aims to lower the investment threshold and increase allocation flexibility. The ETF was established on June 22 2012 with an initial price of NT$30. The split ratio is preliminarily set at 1‑for‑7. Using a net asset value of NT$210 per unit as an example, the post‑split NAV will adjust to NT$30, turning one share into seven, and the full‑share transaction amount estimated by NAV will drop from NT$210,000 to NT$30,000.

Hua Nan Financial (2880‑TW) held its Q3 2026 online institutional briefing on the 26th. Benefiting from stable core banking operations and a sharp profit increase in its non‑bank subsidiaries, its net profit after tax for the first ten months reached NT$28.456 billion, already surpassing last year’s full‑year profit. General Manager Hsiao Yu‑mei said the 2026 dividend payout ratio will aim for about 70% next year, primarily in cash, and the payout level is expected to exceed this year’s.

In early trading on the 26th, the Taipei market was led by a rebound in heavily‑discounted electronics stocks, ending the session up 956.38 points at 39,151.81, with turnover shrinking to NT$8,174.68 billion. Foreign investors remained net sellers, offloading NT$491.81 billion in the main market that day, while domestic investment trusts and proprietary traders were net buyers, supporting the market’s rebound.

Boosted by a major positive from Nvidia founder‑CEO Jensen Huang’s return, the Taiwan market staged a strong rally on Nov 24, with over 50 ETFs hitting limit‑up simultaneously. However, the exchange announced on the 26th that the actively managed Taiwan Growth ETF (00981A‑TW) suffered a massive NT$1.03 billion default settlement, reported by Hua Nan Yong‑Chang Securities Zhongzheng Branch and Cathay Securities Dunnan Branch, marking the first such default for an active ETF.

Semiconductor test interface company Unimicron (6515‑TW) held its earnings briefing on the 26th. Chairman Wang Chia‑huang said the company is benefiting from continued growth in AI and high‑performance computing demand, with major AI chip customers showing strong orders for next year. GPU and ASIC demand is expected to exceed this year’s levels, and the company anticipates double‑digit operational growth next year based on current sales pipeline information.
Fubon 006208 split voting starts on the 27th, estimated 1‑for‑7 split; a single share now costs only NT$30,000.
Hua Nan Financial earnings briefing: dividend‑focused investors take note! The chairman promises next year’s dividend could surpass this year’s, targeting a 70% payout ratio mainly in cash.
Taiwan market climbs back above 39,000; foreign futures and spot remain short, and TSMC withdrawals total nearly NT$390 billion.
Celebration turns sour! 00981A reveals a NT$1.03 billion massive default settlement, the first case for an actively managed ETF.
Unimicron earnings briefing: Chairman says customer demand is very aggressive; next year’s operational growth estimated at double‑digit levels.
U.S. 301 survey released; the Federation of Industries proposes three major recommendations to ensure negotiations avoid industry uncertainty.
Taiwan Business Bank earnings briefing: Q1‑Q3 profit of NT$11.4 billion, up nearly 17% YoY, a new high; SME loans total NT$867.3 billion, leading the market; EPS reaches NT$1.10.
Far Eastern Bank earnings briefing: retained earnings earmarked for next year’s dividend increase; first aim to upgrade to a financial holding company, then discuss securities two‑in‑one.
Want Want China Holdings eyes space‑economy opportunities; revenue expected to grow 25% next year, with satellite communications business doubling.
Research: Global smartphone shipments projected to decline another 6% in 2027, with the earliest recovery expected in 2028.
AI accelerates cyber‑attack threats! The Financial Supervisory Commission issues 14 self‑assessment items, requiring all financial institutions to submit reports to their boards by year‑end.

items.title: 黃仁勳還無可取代？耶魯學者：輝達面臨的考題已經變了
items.title_en: Is Jensen Huang Still Irreplaceable? Yale Scholar Says Nvidia's Challenges Have Changed
paras: 黃仁勳重掌輝達(NVDA-US)，讓他是否「無可取代」成為市場焦點。《彭博》專欄作者Gautam Mukunda認為，黃仁勳過去33年的貢獻確實難以取代，但當輝達面臨的核心挑戰轉向出口管制、法遵與公司治理，答案可能已經改變。
Mukunda在耶魯大學管理學院教授領導力課程，也是《Indispensable: When Leaders Really Matter》一書作者。他指出，領導者的影響力與成功，取決於所處情境；曾讓企業成功的特質，在另一種環境下，也可能成為問題。

押注CUDA的膽識 曾替輝達開創新市場

Mukunda將黃仁勳歸類為「未經組織層層篩選的領導者」。一般大型企業執行長，多半歷經多年考核與升遷，創辦人則可能直接登上最高決策位置，未經同樣的篩選過程。
依他的研究，這類領導者的表現往往更偏離平均，可能極度成功，也可能大幅失敗，甚至在同一段職涯中出現兩種結果。
黃仁勳過去的成績，顯然落在成功的一端。《哈佛商業評論》曾在2017年至2019年，將他列為全球績效最佳執行長之一，而AI熱潮更凸顯他提前布局的眼光。
2006年，黃仁勳堅持推動CUDA，讓開發者能將繪圖處理器(GPU)用於各式運算。參與開發的輝達主管Ian Buck曾表示，這項投入耗資數十億美元，10年沒有賺錢，公司仍未放棄。
2012年，多倫多大學研究人員使用市售輝達晶片訓練神經網路，在影像辨識競賽中大幅領先，也讓AI發展找到重要的硬體基礎。
Mukunda認為，當企業正在建立尚不存在的市場，願意押注革命性創新的創辦人，正好符合當時需求；但企業面臨的問題改變，所需的領導方式也可能不同。

出口管制爭議升高 法遵成為關鍵考驗

Mukunda指出，黃仁勳回任，不會讓輝達面臨的檢視就此結束。他在文中提到，公司正受到先進晶片是否違規流入中國、是否誤導投資人等調查與質疑，黃仁勳也預定赴國會作證。
他並提及，兩黨議員希望透過下個月的國防法案，禁止輝達Blackwell晶片對中國銷售18個月。
在Mukunda看來，輝達接下來必須更加重視法遵，而黃仁勳高度聚焦成長的作風，未必最適合這項任務。
他指出，黃仁勳過去打造的管理架構，約有60人直接向他報告，董事會當時也未設董事長。Mukunda認為，這讓黃仁勳擁有高度控制權，也缺乏足以對他說「不」的人。
作者以克瑞斯(Colette Kress)代理執行長期間的決定為例：她在上任第一周表示，輝達已停止向中國出貨H200晶片，即使美國許可仍允許相關銷售。
Mukunda認為，不論克瑞斯的考量為何，這種審慎態度，可能正是輝達未來幾年所需。

仍需要下一個CUDA 董事會面臨領導難題

黃仁勳與川普的密切關係，也面臨不同的政治環境。Mukunda指出，這層關係去年曾協助輝達取得H20晶片對中銷售許可，但如今共和黨已展開調查，民主黨又將於明年1月掌控國會，反而可能成為政治攻防焦點。
然而，Mukunda也承認，輝達仍需要黃仁勳曾展現的創新膽識。隨著最大客戶開始設計自有晶片，公司可能需要另一個CUDA等級的突破。
這正是他眼中的兩難：催生重大創新的冒險精神，與公司當前必須更加審慎的要求，同時存在於同一位領導者身上。
Mukunda認為，股市重挫與川普施壓，壓縮了輝達董事會的選擇空間。川普稱「有些人無法取代」，但在作者看來，這是在評價黃仁勳過去的成就，尚未回答輝達未來究竟需要哪一種領導者。
他認為，評估領導者的關鍵，在於人與情境是否契合；過去的成功，無法直接證明未來仍不可取代。
paras_en: Jensen Huang's return to the helm of Nvidia (NVDA-US) has made the question of whether he is "irreplaceable" a market focus. Bloomberg columnist Gautam Mukunda argues that while Huang's 33‑year contributions have indeed been hard to replace, the core challenges Nvidia now faces have shifted to export controls, compliance and corporate governance, and the answer may have changed.

Mukunda, who teaches a leadership course at Yale School of Management and authored "Indispensable: When Leaders Really Matter," points out that a leader's influence and success depend on the context; traits that drove success in one environment can become problems in another.

Boldly betting on CUDA created new markets for Nvidia. Mukunda classifies Huang as a "leader who bypassed the usual organizational vetting." In large firms CEOs usually rise after years of assessment, while founders may step directly into top decision‑making without the same screening process.
His research shows that such leaders tend to deviate more from the average—some become extremely successful, others fail dramatically, and both outcomes can occur within the same career.

Huang's track record clearly falls on the successful side. Harvard Business Review listed him among the world’s top‑performing CEOs from 2017 to 2019, and the AI boom further highlighted his foresight in early positioning.

In 2006 Huang pushed for CUDA, enabling developers to use GPUs for general‑purpose computing. Nvidia executive Ian Buck recalled that the effort cost billions of dollars and took a decade to turn a profit, yet the company never gave up.

In 2012 University of Toronto researchers used off‑the‑shelf Nvidia chips to train neural networks, achieving a huge lead in an image‑recognition contest and providing a critical hardware foundation for AI development.

Mukunda believes that when a company is building a market that does not yet exist, a founder willing to bet on revolutionary innovation fits the need; but when the problems change, the required leadership style may also change.

Export‑control controversies rise, compliance becomes a key test. Mukunda notes that Huang’s return will not end the scrutiny Nvidia faces. The company is under investigation for possible illegal chip shipments to China and alleged investor mis‑leadings, and Huang is slated to testify before Congress.
He also mentions that bipartisan lawmakers aim to use next month’s defense bill to ban sales of Nvidia’s Blackwell chips to China for 18 months.
In Mukunda’s view, Nvidia must now place greater emphasis on compliance, and Huang’s growth‑focused style may not be the best fit for that task.
He points out that Huang built a management structure with about 60 direct reports and a board that at the time had no chair, giving him high control but few people able to say "no" to him.

The author cites decisions made by interim CEO Colette Kress: in her first week she announced that Nvidia had stopped shipping H200 chips to China, even though U.S. permission still allowed such sales.
Mukunda argues that regardless of Kress’s motives, this cautious approach may be exactly what Nvidia needs in the coming years.

The next CUDA‑level breakthrough presents a board leadership dilemma. Huang’s close ties with Donald Trump also face a different political climate. Mukunda notes that the relationship helped secure a permit for H20 chip sales to China last year, but now Republicans are investigating and Democrats will control Congress in January, turning the issue into a political battleground.

Nevertheless, Mukunda concedes that Nvidia still needs the innovative daring Huang demonstrated. As its biggest customers begin designing their own chips, the company may require another breakthrough on the scale of CUDA.
That is the dilemma he sees: the adventurous spirit that drives major innovation coexists with the current need for greater caution, both residing in the same leader.

Mukunda believes the market plunge and Trump’s pressure have narrowed the board’s options. Trump said "some people are irreplaceable," but the author sees that as an appraisal of Huang’s past achievements, not an answer to what kind of leader Nvidia will need in the future.
He concludes that evaluating a leader hinges on the fit between the person and the situation; past success does not automatically prove future irreplaceability.

items.title: 別指望聯準會出手救市？Fed傳聲筒：AI股暴跌拉高升息門檻 華許陷政策兩難
paras: 隨著科技股跌勢擴大，聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)正面臨兩難：究竟應該繼續升息、履行打擊通膨的強硬承諾，還是相信他長期重視的市場訊號，認為股市下跌及金融環境緊縮，已能替Fed達到部分抑制通膨的效果？
Fed傳聲筒、《華爾街日報》(WSJ)記者Nick Timiraos撰文指出，AI引發市場崩跌之後，Fed(Fed)升息的門檻已大幅提高。

2018年情景似曾相似 但通膨情勢已不同

Timiraos表示，華許也曾以批評者身分面對與現今類似的情況：2018年12月，美股從高點下跌約11%時，華許與億萬投資人朱肯米勒(Stanley Druckenmiller)曾在WSJ撰文，主張Fed應暫時停止緊縮政策。
然而，Fed當時仍決定升息。由於投資人不滿官員暗示可能進一步升息，股市賣壓加劇，美股創下1931年以來最差的12月表現。幾天後，Fed官員便釋出訊號，表示短期內沒有急於再次升息的打算。
目前的情勢讓人似曾相似：都是新任第一年的Fed主席在股市下跌、美元走強之際升息。決策官員也都面臨地緣政治衝擊，而選民剛在期中選舉中對總統川普投下反對票，川普當時也要求Fed不要緊縮貨幣政策。
但兩個時期最大的差異在於通膨。2018年，經過多年低於目標的情況後，通膨才剛升至Fed 2%的目標水準。但現在，美國通膨已連續超過五年高於目標。華許也曾表示，Fed不會接受通膨持續略高於目標的情況，這使Fed更難像2019年初那樣，以停止升息作為政策回應。

AI需求推升通膨 Fed官員對升息更趨強硬

目前Fed官員的注意力完全集中在通膨。根據美國商務部周三(25日)公布的數據，10月通膨進一步升溫。排除波動較大的食品及能源價格後，一項關鍵通膨指標年增率升至3.3%，高於9月的3.1%。該指標在2025年3月一度低至2.6%，之後川普政府大幅提高進口商品關稅。
展望未來，Fed官員愈來愈擔心，AI正在推升需求，與油價上漲或關稅不同，這類需求成長所帶來的價格壓力，可能不容易自行消退。
有一部分過去不認為企業漲價意願提高構成問題的官員，如今也開始認為這項疑慮確實存在。Fed下個月公布的經濟預測，可能顯示未來還需要進一步升息。
Fed第三把交椅、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)周一告訴記者：「我最關注的不是過去的供給衝擊，而是需求究竟有多強勁，其中很大一部分與AI有關。」
這代表Fed官員對股市賣壓的擔憂，可能不像許多投資人想像的那麼強烈。股價下跌等金融情勢緊縮，正是升息減緩支出、壓低通膨的主要管道之一。
2007年至2021年擔任波士頓聯準銀行總裁的羅森格倫(Eric Rosengren)說：「你可以說，這正是Fed原本想達到的效果。如果想讓經濟降溫，就必須讓AI投資降溫。」
市場波動對Fed而言仍是挑戰，因為官員不希望讓投資人養成一種預期，認為每當股市下跌，央行就會出手緩衝損失。華爾街將這種現象稱為「Fed賣權」(Fed put)。

股市下跌能否替Fed降溫？關鍵在持續時間

讓政策抉擇更加複雜的是，Fed很難即時判斷何時能依賴市場替自己完成緊縮工作，因為金融情勢收緊可能來得極快，而且瞬間反轉。
輝達(NVDA-US)重新任命黃仁勳為執行長後，科技股周一大幅反彈，但由於市場憂心出口管制可能進一步收緊，以及複雜的AI融資安排引發不安，股市隨後再度下跌。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)上周將股市賣壓部分歸咎於Fed官員釋出可能進一步升息的訊號。他周日在CBS受訪時表示：「許多人認為，如果Fed過度緊縮，可能會犯下政策錯誤。」他也提到，投資人擔心民主黨在期中選舉取得進展後，可能放慢AI基礎設施建設。
Fed則有一部分官員認為，有序降溫反而有益於經濟。目前資料中心開發商採購晶片及電力設備的速度，甚至快於供應商交貨能力，使供應商擁有相當大的定價能力。芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)上周表示，企業界人士告訴他，各種電力相關產品的價格都在「飆升」。
Timiraos表示，股市若持續下跌，影響就更值得關注，因為這更可能改變家庭支出及企業融資決策。家庭若感覺財富縮水，通常會減少消費。而仰賴投資人熱情為新專案籌資的企業，也會發現募資難度提高。
這將使需求降溫，Fed官員屆時可能認為，無須升息到原先預期的幅度。
但如果股市賣壓演變成失序崩跌，Fed就會更加憂心，因為這可能讓負債沉重的企業蒙受損失，並引發信貸緊縮，形成自我強化的惡性循環。
威廉斯表示，如果金融情勢出現「重大」且「持續」的變化，將影響他的經濟展望。不過，他形容上周的市場波動「可能只是波動加劇，而非市場從根本上重新評估AI的前景」。

Fed12月升息幾成定局 後續政策分歧擴大

Fed9月已升息，儘管近期市場波動加劇，投資人仍普遍預期，Fed在12月8日至9日會議上將再次升息。之後的政策辯論，則集中在升息速度及最終升息幅度。
部分官員可能願意在再升息一次後暫停，前提是近期油價及其他商品價格下跌趨勢持續，且通膨降溫。過去兩個月，商品及能源價格已經下滑；近期隨著煉油商利潤率收窄，柴油及航空燃油等原油產品價格也進一步回落。
此外，借貸成本提高，加上外界反對興建新資料中心的政治阻力，也可能使部分AI基礎設施建設放緩。
但另一些官員認為，目前利率仍然太低。聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩列姆(Alberto Musalem)提出的計算顯示，明年可能有必要再升息3次。
威廉斯則表示，如果經濟持續成長超過產能負荷，通膨數據也持續高於預期，他不排除連續幾次會議都升息。他說：「你不會只是坐在那裡等待。」
Timiraos表示，從華許過去的發言，還難以判斷他會給近期市場波動多大影響。他長期主張，Fed過度依賴落後的政府經濟數據，應更加重視市場價格，才能避免措手不及，最後被迫出手救市。
例如，華許曾在2016年的一場演說中批評，Fed「系統性地低估即時市場價格訊號的重要性，通常隨後又以遲來且慌亂的政策回應，印證市場對央行賣權的預期」。
2018年10月，華許接受電子報出版商Jim Grant的Podcast訪問時表示，當時經濟「蓬勃發展」，Fed不應對市場波動反應過度。他說：「我希望大家關注的是實體經濟，而不是擔心股市下跌10%，或公債殖利率上升50或75個基點會發生什麼事。這不應該是他們關注的重點。」
然而，10周後，隨著股市賣壓讓風險較高的企業更難借款，華許便開始呼籲Fed暫停升息。
曾任Fed資深顧問的Jon Faust表示，如果市場跌勢進一步加劇，華許如何權衡市場動盪與通膨居高不下的證據，將成為「最核心的問題」。
Timiraos還指出，Fed官員通常比起股市，更密切關注信貸市場。Fed負責監管事務的副主席鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)本月表示，今年AI相關債務規模預計將超過8,000億美元，而與AI基礎設施建設相關的表外承諾，估計規模更超過這個數字的三倍。
前Fed官員羅森格倫表示：「如果開始看到許多負債沉重的企業面臨真正的財務困境，經濟就不只是放緩，而是可能出現非常顯著的衰退機制。」

items.title: AI吸乾全球記憶體產能 缺貨至少到2028年！馬斯克搶貨也碰壁 晶片貴如「金條」引竊賊覬覦
items.title_en: AI Drains Global Memory Chip Capacity, Shortages Expected Until 2028! Musk’s Attempts to Secure Chips Hit Roadblocks, Chips as Expensive as Gold Bars Attract Thieves
paras: AI資料中心火速擴張，引發全球記憶體晶片短缺，全球企業陷入搶貨大戰，成立採購戰情室、轉向灰色市場，甚至甘願支付數十倍價格。缺貨也推升電子產品售價、壓縮業者利潤，並衍生假貨、訂單遭轉賣及晶片竊案。預料供應緊張至少將持續到2028年新廠陸續投產，SK海力士更表示，供不應求將延續到2030年。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ)報導，這波缺貨潮已使部分記憶體晶片價格在過去一年飆升至原本的10倍，整個電子產業跟進漲價。美國民眾在今年年底購物季採購禮物將更加昂貴，例如蘋果(AAPL-US)已把MacBook筆電價格調漲100至500美元，漲幅視機型而定，而今年iPhone 18 Pro和Pro Max起售價也都較去年提高100美元。執行長庫克先前形容，這波晶片短缺就像「百年一遇的大洪水」。
此外，同一款微軟(MSFT-US)Xbox現在售價600美元，比一年前貴33%，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)Echo Dot智慧音箱則漲價60%，來到80美元。Meta(META-US)也將Quest 3虛擬實境頭戴裝置價格調漲50美元，達到350美元。

供給吃緊至少到2028年 新廠產能陸續開出

記憶體晶片一向帶有明顯的景氣循環特質，常經歷供給過剩後又陷入短缺。但現在的市場持續處於供不應求狀態，全球三大記憶體製造商南韓三星電子、SK海力士(SKHY-US)及美國的美光(MU-US)，都來不及快速擴充產能。
這波短缺預料至少會持續到2028年新工廠投入營運，儘管市場已傳出資料中心建設可能放緩的聲音。科技市場分析公司Counterpoint Research預估，全球產業DRAM產能將從今年到2028年增加50%。而DRAM是目前供應限制最嚴重的主要記憶體類型。
SK海力士的DRAM及專為AI運算設計的新一代高頻寬記憶體(HBM)晶片，產能已售罄至2029年。美光則已透過多年合約，預售至少1,500億美元的供應量。
SK海力士財務長Kim Woo-hyun上個月在財報電話會議中說：「供應無法跟上需求的情況，預料還會持續一段時間，這項限制可能延續至2030年。」

「這太瘋狂了！」全球買家赴韓搶貨

過去的長期供貨協議通常都是客戶與供應商之間的口頭承諾，但現在，雙方都開始尋求最長五年的具約束力合約，並要求客戶預付約25%至30%的採購成本，甚至分攤新工廠的投資成本。
晶片買家更是紛紛進駐韓國，希望爭取三星與SK海力士供貨。科技業高層表示，部分AI巨頭甚至安排員工住在三星晶片工廠附近的住宅區，每天前往確認進度，以確保交貨順利。
美國豪華車廠Karma Automotive執行長Marques McCammon這半年已四度飛往韓國，拜訪一家主要記憶體供應商，頻繁程度甚至讓他在首爾有了自己最喜歡的烤肉店。
McCammon表示，雖然對方願意洽談，然而一旦涉及敲定價格和交貨日期，就會開始閃爍其詞。他說：「出於禮貌，他們會撥出時間會面，但要真正做出決定非常困難。」
台灣隨身碟製造商宇瞻科技(Apacer)(8271-TW)則透過貸款預留資金，以便一旦有晶片供貨，就能立即搶購。該公司副董事長陳明達說：「只要晶片出現，我們就買。這太瘋狂了，但沒有其他辦法。」

就連SpaceX(SPCX-US)與特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)也遭遇相同困境，根據Capital Group投資組合經理Carl Kawaja，馬斯克在6月一場研討會上透露，他曾向三星提出長期晶片採購承諾，但三星會長李在鎔回他，「其他所有人也都提出相同條件，你還能提供什麼？」接著，當馬斯克提出願為三星新晶片工廠提供融資擔保，李在鎔的回答仍是：「其他人也都提出這項條件，你還能拿出什麼？」

成立採購戰情室、轉向灰色市場

位於美國拉斯維加斯的供應鏈顧問公司Seraph，有一家客戶是美國先進駕駛輔助系統(ADAS)開發商，為了取得晶片，不得不轉向數百家獨立經紀商及灰色市場採購。
Seraph執行長Ambrose Conroy表示，該客戶為某項特定零組件支付的價格，最高達原先預算的40倍。這家客戶無法將增加的成本轉嫁給汽車製造商客戶，導致利潤率受到侵蝕，明年恐怕不得不漲價。
Seraph許多客戶企業已成立採購團隊，如今每周有六天待在臨時設置的戰情室。他們透過試算表整理資訊，主動致電數百家獨立經紀商，並大量寄送電子郵件，四處尋找零散庫存。
Conroy表示，有一家Seraph客戶曾找到一批由中國經紀商持有的韓國記憶體模組，但公司花了五天才完成內部程序，核准電匯付款。等到程序完成時，報價已經失效，經紀商開出的價格更暴漲50%。這家公司最終決定放棄交易。

記憶體身價暴漲 連倉庫也成竊賊目標

另一個困擾整個產業的新問題，是晶片竊案。
影視製作軟硬體開發商Blackmagic Design表示，去年底位於印尼的一座倉庫遭竊，失竊物品包括8TB快閃記憶體產品，價值約10萬美元。該公司懷疑這起竊案是由一名前員工策劃，在那之後增加全天候警衛人力，並擴大倉庫監控系統。
Petty說：「這不是我們原本預料會發生的事。它們已經不只是記憶體晶片，而是記憶體金條，因為一旦價格漲到某個程度，就成了可以交易的財富。」
paras_en: AI data centers are expanding rapidly, causing a global shortage of memory chips and sparking a battle for supplies among companies worldwide. They have set up procurement war rooms, turned to the grey market, and are even willing to pay dozens of times the price. The shortage has pushed up the prices of electronic products, squeezed company profits, and led to counterfeit goods, order resales, and chip theft cases. Supply tightness is expected to last at least until 2028 as new plants come online, and SK Hynix has said the demand‑supply gap will continue until 2030.

The Wall Street Journal reports that this shortage has pushed some memory chip prices up to ten times their original levels over the past year, and the entire electronics industry has followed suit with price increases. U.S. consumers will face higher costs during this year’s holiday shopping season; for example, Apple (AAPL‑US) has raised MacBook laptop prices by $100 to $500 depending on the model, and the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max launch prices are also $100 higher than last year. CEO Tim Cook previously described the chip shortage as a "once‑in‑a‑century flood."

In addition, the same Microsoft (MSFT‑US) Xbox now sells for $600, 33% more than a year ago, while Amazon (AMZN‑US) Echo Dot smart speakers have increased by 60% to $80. Meta (META‑US) has also raised the price of its Quest 3 VR headset by $50 to $350.

Supply is tight at least until 2028 as new plant capacity comes online. Memory chips have always shown clear cyclical characteristics, often experiencing oversupply followed by shortages. But the current market remains in a state of supply‑demand imbalance, and the world’s three major memory manufacturers—South Korea’s Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix (SKHY‑US), and U.S. Micron (MU‑US)—cannot quickly expand capacity.

This shortage is expected to last at least until 2028 when new factories become operational, even though there are reports that data‑center construction may slow down. Counterpoint Research, a technology market analysis firm, estimates that global DRAM capacity will increase by 50% from this year to 2028. DRAM is the type of memory most severely limited in supply.

SK Hynix’s DRAM and its new high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) chips designed for AI computing are sold out through 2029. Micron has pre‑sold at least $150 billion worth of supply through long‑term contracts.
SK Hynix CFO Kim Woo‑hyun said in a recent earnings call that the supply shortfall will continue for a while and that the restriction could last until 2030.

"This is insane!" Global buyers flock to Korea to secure chips. Long‑term supply agreements were previously verbal commitments between customers and suppliers, but now both sides are seeking binding contracts up to five years, requiring customers to prepay 25% to 30% of the purchase cost and even share new plant investment costs.

Chip buyers are moving into Korea to secure supplies from Samsung and SK Hynix. Tech executives say some AI giants even arrange for employees to live in residential areas near Samsung’s chip plants and visit daily to confirm progress and ensure smooth delivery.

Karma Automotive CEO Marques McCammon has flown to Korea four times in the past six months to visit a major memory supplier, and his frequent visits have even earned him a favorite barbecue restaurant in Seoul.

McCammon said that although the supplier is willing to negotiate, once price and delivery dates are involved, they start to waver. He said, "Out of politeness, they will set a meeting time, but making a real decision is very difficult."

Apacer (8271‑TW), a Taiwanese flash drive manufacturer, has reserved funds through loans so that it can immediately purchase chips when supply becomes available. Vice Chairman Chen Ming‑da said, "As soon as chips appear, we buy. It’s insane, but there’s no other way."

Even SpaceX (SPCX‑US) and Tesla (TSLA‑US) CEO Elon Musk has faced the same dilemma. According to Capital Group portfolio manager Carl Kawaja, Musk revealed at a June seminar that he had offered Samsung a long‑term chip purchase commitment, but Samsung Chairman Lee Jae‑yong replied, "Everyone else has made the same offer; what can you offer?" When Musk offered to provide financing guarantees for Samsung’s new chip plant, Lee’s answer was the same: "Everyone else has made this condition; what can you offer?"

A procurement war room was set up and the grey market was turned to. Seraph, a supply‑chain consulting firm in Las Vegas, has a client that is an American advanced driver‑assist system (ADAS) developer. To obtain chips, the client had to turn to hundreds of independent brokers and the grey market.

Seraph CEO Ambrose Conroy said the client paid up to 40 times the original budget for a specific component. The client could not pass the increased cost onto its automotive manufacturer customers, eroding profit margins and likely forcing a price increase next year.

Many of Seraph’s client companies have established procurement teams, and now they spend six days a week in a temporary war room. They use spreadsheets to organize information, proactively call hundreds of independent brokers, and send large volumes of emails to find scattered inventory.

Conroy said a Seraph client once found a batch of Korean memory modules held by a Chinese broker, but the company took five days to complete internal procedures and approve a wire transfer. By the time the process was finished, the quote had expired and the broker’s price had risen 50%. The company ultimately decided to abandon the deal.
The price of memory has skyrocketed, and warehouses have become targets for thieves. Another new problem troubling the entire industry is chip theft.

Blackmagic Design, a film and television production software and hardware developer, said that at the end of last year a warehouse in Indonesia was robbed, with stolen items including 8 TB flash memory products worth about $100,000. The company suspects the theft was planned by a former employee, and has since increased 24‑hour security personnel and expanded its warehouse monitoring system.
Petty said, "This is not something we expected to happen. They’re no longer just memory chips; they’re memory gold bars, because once the price rises to a certain level, they become tradable wealth."

items.title: 外資連4賣仍大漲7%  南亞受惠高階AI材料攀升、法人持續調高目標價
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Sell Four Consecutive Days Yet Stock Soars 7% – Nanya Benefits from Rising High‑End AI Materials, Institutional Investors Raise Target Price
paras: 南亞(1301-TW)今(26)日雖遭外資連4賣，已大賣1.9萬張，但今股價仍隨大盤大漲近千點下，開高走高大漲7.73%，收244元，站回5日線。據本土法人報告指出，南亞因電子材料高階產品比重持續提升，在產品組合改善下，有利中長期營運成長動能，投資建議為「買進」，也調高南亞目標價。
本土法人指出，南亞今年在高階產品有望放量，營收維持成長態勢；化工EG則因中國EG陸續到港，後續利差將縮減；聚酯產品方面，紡織及瓶用粒市況較為不佳，將積極擴大電子用途的比重；塑膠加工部 門表現則是維持穩健。
法人預估，南亞今(2026)年受惠於AI伺服器市規模持續擴大，南亞電子材 料產品營收將維持增長態勢，產品組合的改善有望提升整體營運表現，加上業外南亞科(2408-TW)獲利貢獻增加，預估南亞今年稅後純益，有望挑戰超過一個股本。
法人也看好，南亞在明(2027)年電子材料高階產品比重有望持續提高、帶動營收及營益率持續增長，加上持股南亞科獲利貢獻增加之下，有望超越今年獲利水準。
外資則指出，台股今年從歷史高點迄今回檔幅度逼近3成，之前備受關注的電子AI全淪為重災區，目前包括大摩觀察，不少千金股財務遭下修，南亞成為外資看好的股票之一。
據外資表示，南亞在產品組合加速升級下，至2028年，包括今年，每年朝多賺一個股本腳步邁進，目前南亞股價雖仍守在半年線，但看好後市的外資預估目標價比本土法人估300元，更調高到500元以上。
paras_en: Nanya (1301‑TW) was sold by foreign investors for the fourth consecutive day today (the 26th), with a total of 19,000 lots sold, but its share price still rose sharply alongside the market’s near‑1,000‑point surge, opening higher and climbing 7.73% to close at NT$244, back above the 5‑day moving average. According to a domestic institutional report, Nanya’s increasing proportion of high‑end electronic materials improves its product mix, supporting medium‑ to long‑term operational momentum, and the investment recommendation is "Buy" with an upgraded target price.

Domestic institutions note that Nanya is expected to scale up its high‑end products this year, keeping revenue on a growth trajectory; its chemical EG business faces narrowing margins as Chinese EG shipments arrive in Hong Kong; polyester products see weaker demand in textile and bottle‑grade markets, prompting a push to expand the share of electronic applications; and the plastics processing division remains stable.

Institutions estimate that in 2026 Nanya will benefit from the continued expansion of the AI server market, with revenue from its electronic materials segment maintaining growth. The improved product mix should boost overall performance, and with increased profit contribution from its affiliate Nanya Technology (2408‑TW), Nanya’s after‑tax net profit this year is projected to exceed one times its equity base.

Institutions are also optimistic that in 2027 Nanya’s share of high‑end electronic materials will keep rising, driving revenue and operating margin growth, and with higher profit contributions from its stake in Nanya Technology, the company is expected to surpass this year’s profit level.

Foreign investors point out that Taiwan’s stock market has fallen nearly 30% from its historical peak this year, and the previously hot electronic AI sector has become a disaster zone. Observers such as Morgan Stanley note that many blue‑chip stocks have seen earnings revisions downward, while Nanya is among the stocks foreign investors view favorably.

Foreign investors say that with Nanya’s product mix accelerating its upgrade, the company is on track to add roughly one equity base per year through 2028, including this year. Although the share price is still hovering around the six‑month moving average, foreign investors are bullish on the outlook and have raised their target price to over NT$500, compared with the domestic institutions’ estimate of NT$300.

items.title: 國科會「創新創業計畫」累計民間投資達135億元 已培養600家新創公司
items.title_en: National Science Council's Innovation and Entrepreneurship Program Accumulates Private Investment of NT$13.5 Billion, Cultivates 600 Startups
paras: 由國科會指導、國研院科政中心執行之「創新創業激勵計畫」(FITI)，今(26)日舉辦2026年第2梯次決選暨頒獎典禮，典禮揭曉本梯次「創業傑出獎」得主，將獲得由企業贊助的100萬元創業基金。
國研院表示，「創新創業激勵計畫」自2013年推動至今，持續協助學研團隊將科研成果轉化為創業構想，累計輔導上千組學研新創團隊，成功培育近600家新創公司，促成民間投資金額逾135億元，也透過長期培育與資源鏈結，逐步建立從科研創新、創業培育到產業發展的支持機制。
「創新創業激勵計畫」藉由6個月的系統化培訓，協助學研團隊逐步建立創業所需的能力。培訓架構涵蓋兩場沉浸式商業發展營隊、五大核心課程及三階段評選機制，並提供智財專利、募資規劃、國際策略與計畫書診斷等顧問資源，協助團隊完善創業規劃、鏈結市場需求，進一步提升科研成果的商業價值，經由持續優化商業模式與各階段評選，選出7支團隊進入最終決選暨頒獎典禮。
本次晉級決選的團隊表現亮眼，透過成果攤位展示與現場簡報，向與會嘉賓展現具市場應用潛力的研發成果，領域涵蓋AI智慧科技、資訊安全、健康醫療、環境永續及新能源材料等關鍵項目，充分展現科研技術跨足不同產業領域的應用潛力。
國研院科政中心也藉此機會，感謝各贊助企業的長期支持，該計畫之所以能建構師資堅強、資源豐沛的新創交流平台，有賴台積電(2330-TW)、宏碁(2353-TW)基金會、理律法律事務所及宏匯集團t.Hub內科創新育成基地等企業全力相挺，企業不僅為計畫注入關鍵資金，更是帶動臺灣新創生態系持續茁壯的重要推手。
paras_en: The Innovation and Entrepreneurship Incentive Program (FITI), guided by the National Science Council and implemented by the Science and Technology Policy Center of the Academia Sinica, held its 2026 second‑round finals and award ceremony on the 26th. The ceremony announced the winner of this round’s “Outstanding Entrepreneurship Award,” who will receive a NT$1 million startup fund sponsored by a corporation.

The Academia Sinica noted that since its launch in 2013, the Innovation and Entrepreneurship Incentive Program has continuously helped academic‑research teams turn scientific results into business ideas, having mentored over a thousand such teams, successfully nurturing nearly 600 startups and attracting more than NT$13.5 billion of private investment. Through long‑term cultivation and resource linking, it is gradually building a support mechanism that spans scientific innovation, entrepreneurial training, and industrial development.

The program provides a six‑month systematic training that helps research teams gradually acquire the skills needed for entrepreneurship. The curriculum includes two immersive business‑development bootcamps, five core courses, and a three‑stage selection process, as well as consulting resources such as intellectual‑property advice, fundraising planning, international strategy, and proposal review, enabling teams to refine their business plans, connect with market demand, and enhance the commercial value of their research. After continuous business‑model optimization and stage‑wise evaluations, seven teams were selected for the final showdown and award ceremony.

The teams advancing to the finals showcased impressive performances, presenting their R&D results at exhibition booths and live presentations to the audience. Their projects span key areas such as AI smart technology, information security, health care, environmental sustainability, and new‑energy materials, demonstrating the cross‑industry application potential of scientific technologies.

The Science and Technology Policy Center of Academia Sinica also took the opportunity to thank the sponsoring companies for their long‑term support. The program’s strong faculty and abundant resources are made possible by the full backing of firms such as TSMC (2330‑TW), Acer (2353‑TW) Foundation, Lilu Law Firm, and the t.Hub Innovation Incubation Base of the Honghui Group. These enterprises not only inject crucial funding into the program but also act as key drivers of Taiwan’s thriving startup ecosystem.

items.title: 〈華南金法說〉央行不排除年底前升息！蕭玉美看AI與出口支撐動能 台幣震盪偏升
items.title_en: Southland Financial Earnings Call: Central Bank May Raise Rates Before Year‑End; Xiao Yu‑mei Sees AI and Exports Supporting Momentum, NTD Slightly Upward
paras: 華南金 (2880-TW) 總經理蕭玉美今(26)日於法說會指出，受惠人工智慧產業發展與出口投資需求延續，預估明年台灣經濟成長率仍可達5.82%。在利率方面，預期美國聯準會今年底至明年第1季仍有升息空間，台灣央行今年底前亦不排除升息可能；匯率部分，台灣經濟基本面穩健，蕭玉美預期新台幣將呈現區間震盪偏升格局。
觀察全球經濟情勢，蕭玉美認為2027年全球人工智慧產業與相關投資仍將持續成長，成為支撐景氣的重要力量。然而，高油價、利率走向及地緣政治不確定性等因素，仍會對全球經濟成長動能帶來波動影響。反觀國內經濟，根據央行預估，今年台灣經濟成長率約11.48%，明年在人工智慧需求、出口與投資帶動下，並進一步推升民間消費，即便在高基期下，明年經濟成長率仍預估有5.82%的表現。
針對市場關注的利率政策，蕭玉美分析，美國經濟與就業市場表現穩健，但通膨壓力依然偏高，因此預期聯準會從今年底到明年第1季仍有升息空間，後續將視通膨與經濟情勢調整貨幣政策，內部評估最快要到明年年底才可望啟動降息。至於國內利率走向，考量台灣經濟維持強勁成長與通膨情勢，預期台灣央行在今年底前仍有升息可能，進入2027年後隨著通膨壓力逐步緩和，政策利率可望維持穩定。
在匯率走勢方面，蕭玉美表示，台灣經濟基本面表現相當穩健，有助於提供新台幣匯價良好的支撐與穩定度。不過，匯市仍會受到國內外利差、國際資金流向以及企業海外投資等因素交互影響。綜合評估各項變數後，蕭玉美明確指出，內部預期新台幣匯率未來將呈現區間震盪偏升的格局，集團也將持續掌握台商全球布局與跨境金融需求，擴大外匯與金融市場操作收益。
面對全球利率與金融市場波動，華南金強調將靈活調度資產配置，目前華南銀行台債部位約3,600億元、外債約新台幣4,600億元，存續期間分別約3年與1.7年，整體利率風險可控。未來債券投資將維持以5年期以內、信評較佳的公債與公司債為優先標的，股票部位則依市況彈性調整，在有效控管風險的前提下，維持集團穩健的獲利成長動能。
paras_en: Southland Financial (2880‑TW) General Manager Xiao Yu‑mei said at today’s earnings conference that, benefiting from the development of the artificial‑intelligence industry and continued export‑investment demand, Taiwan’s economy is projected to grow 5.82% next year. Regarding interest rates, she expects the U.S. Federal Reserve to have room for hikes from the end of this year into Q1 2025, and the Taiwan central bank also does not rule out a rate increase before year‑end; on exchange rates, she foresees the New Taiwan dollar trading in a range with a slight upward bias as Taiwan’s economic fundamentals remain solid.

Observing the global economic landscape, Xiao believes the worldwide AI sector and related investments will keep expanding through 2027, becoming a key driver of growth. However, high oil prices, interest‑rate trajectories and geopolitical uncertainties will still cause volatility in global growth momentum. Domestically, the central bank estimates Taiwan’s growth at about 11.48% this year, and next year, driven by AI demand, exports and investment that will further boost private consumption, the economy is still expected to post a 5.82% growth rate despite the high base.

Addressing market concerns about rate policy, Xiao analyses that the U.S. economy and labor market remain robust, but inflation pressure stays elevated, so she expects the Fed to have room for hikes from year‑end into Q1 2025 and to adjust policy based on inflation and economic conditions, with the earliest cut likely not until the end of next year. For domestic rates, given Taiwan’s strong growth and inflation outlook, the central bank may still raise rates before year‑end, and after 2027, as inflation eases, the policy rate should remain stable.

On exchange‑rate trends, Xiao notes that Taiwan’s solid economic fundamentals provide good support and stability for the NTD. Nevertheless, the FX market will be influenced by domestic‑foreign interest‑rate differentials, international capital flows and overseas corporate investment. After evaluating these variables, she clearly expects the NTD to trade in a range with a slight upward bias, and the group will continue to capture Taiwanese businesses’ global expansion and cross‑border financing needs to expand foreign‑exchange and financial‑market earnings.

Facing global rate and financial‑market volatility, Southland Financial emphasizes flexible asset‑allocation. Currently, Southland Bank holds about NT$360 billion in Taiwan government bonds and NT$460 billion in foreign bonds, with maturities of roughly three years and 1.7 years respectively, keeping overall rate risk manageable. Future bond investments will prioritize government and corporate bonds with maturities under five years and strong credit ratings, while equity positions will be adjusted flexibly according to market conditions, maintaining the group’s steady profit‑growth momentum under effective risk control.

items.title: 從半導體研究到產業創新 陽明交大頒授鈺創董事長盧超群名譽博士
items.title_en: From Semiconductor Research to Industry Innovation, Yang Ming Chiao Tung Awards Honorary Doctorate to Yuchuang Chairman Lu Chaoqun
paras: 陽明交大今(26)日舉行名譽博士學位頒授典禮，頒授名譽博士學位予鈺創科技董事長暨陽明交大講座教授盧超群博士，表彰其長年深耕半導體研究與IC設計領域，推動臺灣半導體產業技術創新及國際發展的卓越貢獻。
盧超群博士為國際知名半導體專家，畢業於國立臺灣大學，並取得美國史丹佛大學電機工程碩、博士學位，曾於IBM總部投入半導體研究，研發多項創新記憶體元件。1981至1982年間，盧超群返臺於交通大學電子研究所擔任副教授，與學校結下深厚淵源。1990年代響應政府號召返臺，參與國家8吋晶片「次微米計畫」的規劃與推動，協助臺灣建立自主先進半導體製造能力，為後續產業發展奠定重要基礎。
除了學術研究，盧超群更積極將技術創新轉化為產業實力。1991年創立鈺創科技，並相繼共同創辦欣銓科技與創意電子，持續拓展臺灣半導體產業的技術與應用版圖。他早年率先推動裸晶（KGD）技術與異質整合（HI）理念，並促成IEEE於2017年制定異質整合藍圖。近年更提出「矽世代4.0」概念，倡議半導體產業從晶片技術持續邁向系統整合與價值創新。
盧超群在半導體領域的成就深獲國際肯定，不僅當選美國國家工程院院士、美國國家發明學院院士及IEEE Fellow，更獲頒IEEE固態電路獎章等重要殊榮，累積擁有389項全球專利，其中包括105項美國專利，展現其橫跨基礎研究、技術發明與產業應用的深厚實力。
在推動產業發展之餘，盧超群也始終重視學術傳承與人才培育。他與半導體先驅施敏院士具有深厚師生情誼，深受其研究成就與教育理念啟發。事業有成後，持續支持母校電機及半導體領域的研究發展，並投入電機學院「施敏傳承講座」及IEEE電子元件學會「Simon M. Sze Education Award」，延續前輩科學家的學術精神，鼓勵年輕世代投入科技研究。
盧超群分享，從研究走向創業，始終希望將累積的知識與經驗，結合臺灣人才的專業與創造力，開發能夠創新量產、銷售全球的半導體產品。儘管過程充滿挑戰，家人與好友的信任和支持，始終是他持續前進的重要力量。
陽明交大校長林奇宏表示，盧超群不僅是享譽國際的半導體產業領袖，更是兼具創新精神與學術傳承使命的典範。從投入尖端研究、協助臺灣建立半導體自主技術，到創辦企業、推動產業升級，盧超群的經歷見證臺灣半導體產業的發展歷程，也展現科技人才如何透過創新與實踐，為國家產業發展創造長遠價值。
paras_en: Yang Ming Chiao Tung University held an honorary doctorate conferral ceremony today (the 26th), awarding an honorary doctorate to Dr. Lu Chaoqun, chairman of Yuchuang Technology and a distinguished professor at the university, in recognition of his long‑standing contributions to semiconductor research and IC design, and his outstanding role in promoting technological innovation and international development of Taiwan's semiconductor industry.

Dr. Lu is an internationally renowned semiconductor expert, a graduate of National Taiwan University, and holds master’s and doctoral degrees in electrical engineering from Stanford University. He worked on semiconductor research at IBM’s headquarters, developing several innovative memory devices. From 1981 to 1982 he returned to Taiwan to serve as an associate professor in the Institute of Electronics at National Chiao Tung University, forging deep ties with the school. In the 1990s, responding to a government call, he came back to participate in the planning and promotion of the national 8‑inch “sub‑micron” chip project, helping Taiwan build autonomous advanced semiconductor manufacturing capability and laying a crucial foundation for later industry growth.

Beyond academic research, Lu has actively turned technological innovation into industrial strength. He founded Yuchuang Technology in 1991 and later co‑founded Xinquan Technology and Creative Electronics, continuously expanding Taiwan’s semiconductor technology and application landscape. Early on he championed bare‑die (KGD) technology and heterogeneous integration (HI) concepts, contributing to IEEE’s 2017 heterogeneous integration roadmap. In recent years he introduced the “Silicon Generation 4.0” concept, urging the semiconductor industry to move from chip technology toward system integration and value innovation.

Lu’s achievements in the semiconductor field have earned strong international recognition. He has been elected a member of the U.S. National Academy of Engineering, a fellow of the National Academy of Inventors, and an IEEE Fellow, and has received prestigious honors such as the IEEE Solid‑State Circuits Medal. He holds 389 global patents, including 105 U.S. patents, demonstrating deep expertise spanning basic research, technological invention, and industrial application.

In addition to driving industry development, Lu places great emphasis on academic legacy and talent cultivation. He maintains a close mentor‑student relationship with semiconductor pioneer Prof. Shi‑Min, drawing inspiration from his research achievements and educational philosophy. After achieving business success, he continues to support his alma mater’s electrical and semiconductor research, contributing to the “Shi‑Min Legacy Lecture” at the College of Electrical Engineering and the IEEE Components Society’s “Simon M. Sze Education Award,” continuing the academic spirit of his predecessor and encouraging the younger generation to pursue scientific research.

Lu shared that moving from research to entrepreneurship, he always aims to combine accumulated knowledge and experience with Taiwan’s talent, expertise, and creativity to develop semiconductor products that can be innovatively mass‑produced and sold worldwide. Although the process is full of challenges, the trust and support of his family and friends remain the key driving force behind his continued progress.

President Lin Qihong of Yang Ming Chiao Tung University said that Lu is not only an internationally acclaimed leader of the semiconductor industry but also a model who embodies both innovative spirit and a mission of academic inheritance. From pioneering cutting‑edge research and helping Taiwan establish autonomous semiconductor technology to founding companies and advancing industry upgrades, Lu’s journey mirrors the development of Taiwan’s semiconductor sector and shows how technology talent can create long‑term national industrial value through innovation and practice.

台股盤前要聞

paras_en: Fubon Asset Management held a press conference on the 26th to launch the split voting for its Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208‑TW). Electronic voting will be open from Nov 27 to Dec 15, with a written beneficiary meeting on Dec 18. The split aims to lower the investment threshold and increase allocation flexibility. The ETF was established on June 22 2012 with an initial price of NT$30. The split ratio is preliminarily set at 1‑for‑7. Using a net asset value of NT$210 per unit as an example, the post‑split NAV will adjust to NT$30, turning one share into seven, and the full‑share transaction amount estimated by NAV will drop from NT$210,000 to NT$30,000.

Hua Nan Financial (2880‑TW) held its Q3 2026 online institutional briefing on the 26th. Benefiting from stable core banking operations and a sharp profit increase in its non‑bank subsidiaries, its net profit after tax for the first ten months reached NT$28.456 billion, already surpassing last year’s full‑year profit. General Manager Hsiao Yu‑mei said the 2026 dividend payout ratio will aim for about 70% next year, primarily in cash, and the payout level is expected to exceed this year’s.

In early trading on the 26th, the Taipei market was led by a rebound in heavily‑discounted electronics stocks, ending the session up 956.38 points at 39,151.81, with turnover shrinking to NT$8,174.68 billion. Foreign investors remained net sellers, offloading NT$491.81 billion in the main market that day, while domestic investment trusts and proprietary traders were net buyers, supporting the market’s rebound.

Boosted by a major positive from Nvidia founder‑CEO Jensen Huang’s return, the Taiwan market staged a strong rally on Nov 24, with over 50 ETFs hitting limit‑up simultaneously. However, the exchange announced on the 26th that the actively managed Taiwan Growth ETF (00981A‑TW) suffered a massive NT$1.03 billion default settlement, reported by Hua Nan Yong‑Chang Securities Zhongzheng Branch and Cathay Securities Dunnan Branch, marking the first such default for an active ETF.

Semiconductor test interface company Unimicron (6515‑TW) held its earnings briefing on the 26th. Chairman Wang Chia‑huang said the company is benefiting from continued growth in AI and high‑performance computing demand, with major AI chip customers showing strong orders for next year. GPU and ASIC demand is expected to exceed this year’s levels, and the company anticipates double‑digit operational growth next year based on current sales pipeline information.
